name: kallim-hooks
description: Dev-only npm layer: exists solely to wire the shared commit-msg gate (husky + @casomoltd/tooling commitlint) into this Python repo. Not the project toolchain — checks, deps and versioning are uv (see CLAUDE.md). There is deliberately no `check` script: @casomoltd/tooling's check-gates requires eight named npm scripts, so the shipped pre-commit/pre-push cannot apply here; .husky/pre-push calls uv directly instead.
